page: Microsoft Azure E32s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance, though it is Premium Storage capable for external disk attachments.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in specific workloads. The server achieves a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 35.62 GB/sec and a static web serving throughput of 43.89 GB/sec, both ranking in the top 25% of tested systems. Large-block memory bandwidth reaches 181.75 GB/sec for read operations and 77.85 GB/sec for write operations. In terms of computational benchmarks, the stress-ng multi-core CPU performance score is 31862.21, and the PassMark CPU score is 47694.11. For AI workloads, the system processes 186.24 tokens/sec for medium 7B LLM prompt processing and generates 298.63 tokens/sec for small 135M models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E32s_v7 offers a dense memory profile and dedicated CPU allocation without the added cost of bundled local NVMe storage, making it a viable option for workloads reliant on external network-attached storage. The high memory capacity and strong memory bandwidth make this instance well-suited for memory-intensive applications, including relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise applications, and medium-scale language model inference tasks.
